editorial:
Imagine you are hanging out with a group of teenagers who have zero respect for the dead. In this flick, you follow these greedy kids who make a living stealing coins from the mouths of corpses, which is a big no-no in Thai culture. The vibe starts off as a crime story but quickly turns into a nightmare when they decide to rob a wealthy man who had a mouthful of gold. You can feel the tension build as they realize they messed with the wrong person, and the movie does a great job of making you feel uneasy about what is lurking in the shadows.

What really works here are the scary moments and the way the ghost catches up to them. The acting feels natural, and the pacing keeps you on your toes without feeling too slow. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the scares still land well. If you love creepy stories about karma, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the greedy teenagers paying a heavy price for their crimes. The ghost of the millionaire does not stop until every single coin is returned. In the final scenes, the remaining kids are hunted down one by one in brutal ways. The twist is that the ghost wants more than just his gold; he wants their souls. By the end, the survivors realize that greed leads to a dead end, and the spirit finally finds peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural horror and stories about ghosts seeking revenge.
